chapter: Early life, family and Crescent Orchestra
title: Learning piano and his first concert
summary: After violin he moved to piano, learned from Miss Laura Albert, and played a classical concert at a church.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: When did you take up the piano? Well, I'd taken piano.
After violin, my sister was a pianist. And got disgust of it, a war ration from my mother, helping my mother out. And piano laid up, so my brother put me on the piano.

Well, my first teacher was a lady by the name of Miss Laura Albert. She'd go around visiting houses teaching on Tuesdays and Fridays. And then, from my violin, I played for her, and she put on a concert. So the concert formed at Western Chapel's church. That's up on Liberty, between Adila and Saratoga. And I played, my first number was Waves of the Danube Walls, which is now Al Jolson taking it, and made an anniversary song.
Was the whole program classical music in this concert? Oh yeah.
One of the, who else was there for the concert? I don't know about that. Just the two of you.
Well, I played in Miss Albert. She played the piano component, you see.
